correctness.rationale: The graph has n=3^r>=3 distinct rim neighbors, and R=F_q[z,z^-1]/(z^n-1)=F_q[epsilon]/(epsilon^n). With delta=epsilon^2/(1+epsilon), the 4x4 R-companion wave T obeys Phi_5(T)=delta(T^3+T) and T^5-I=delta U, U=T(T-I)(T^2+I). U reduces to a unit: roots of Phi_5 in characteristic three are nontrivial fifth roots, excluding 1 and square roots of -1. For 5∤k, T^k-I is invertible; for k=5*3^j*h, 3∤h, its kernel is the kernel of delta^(3^j) on R^4, dimension 4 min(n,2*3^j). This proves every fixed-space cardinality and the exact order 5n (last proper level j=r-1). Möbius/nested subtraction gives primitive period counts; no transient since T invertible. Independent direct GF(3) modular matrix tests at n=3,9,27 reproduce exact orders 15,45,135 and nullities [8,12],[8,24,36],[8,24,72,108]. Finite checks corroborate but do not replace the R-module proof.
